summary: Neo Ensemble's chorus with one voice: freq the LFO in Hz, min. delay and depth (the sweep's ends) its delay at the sweep's geometric centre and its octaves, feedback to ±99 %, dry out and wet out a crossfade and an output gain. An inverted dry or wet has no counterpart.

rules.why: Both in Hz (Jeskola: hundredths of a Hz).
Both in %; Neo Ensemble's stops at ±99 %.
Jeskola Chorus adds its dry and wet at their own levels; Neo Ensemble crossfades them and sets the output's level: mix = wet ÷ (dry + wet), output = dry + wet.
